title: UMniki Wobulumko Obungenasiphelo
intro: Umntu ohlonitshwayo, owaziwa ngokuqonda kwakhe okunzulu kunye neengcebiso zakhe ezikrelekrele, wakha wanikela isiluleko esingaphaya kwezizukulwana. Amazwi abo, abhalwe kwizibhalo ezingcwele, akhokela abantu ekuboniseni umbulelo, umonde, kunye nokuziphatha okulungileyo.
clues: Ndimcebise umntwana wam ngezona zono zinkulu: ukunxulumana namaqabane no-Allah.
Ndifundise ngobunzima bezenzo, kwanexabiso lembewu yemostade, nendlela uAllah aza kuyivelisa ngayo.
Ndigxininise umbulelo ku-Allah nakubazali, ndivuma ubunzima bokukhulisa umntwana.
Icebiso lam laliquka ukumisela umthandazo, ukuyalela okulungileyo, ukuthintela ububi, nokunyamezela ngomonde oko kuyehlela umntu.
Isahluko kwiQuran sibizwa ngegama lam, siqulathe iimfundiso zam kunye nezifundo endabelana ngazo.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
